verses.en: For the Leader. A Psalm of David.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

verses.he: חַלְּצֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה מֵאָדָ֣ם רָ֑ע מֵאִ֖ישׁ חֲמָסִ֣ים תִּנְצְרֵֽנִי׃
verses.ar: أَنْقِذْنِي يَارَبُّ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلشَّرِّ. مِنْ رَجُلِ ٱلظُّلْمِ ٱحْفَظْنِي.
verses.en: Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man; preserve me from the violent man;
verses.kjv: Deliver me, O LORD, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;
verses.web: Deliver me, Yahweh, from evil men. Preserve me from violent men:

verses.he: אֲשֶׁ֤ר חָשְׁב֣וּ רָעֹ֣ות בְּלֵ֑ב כָּל־יֹ֝֗ום יָג֥וּרוּ מִלְחָמֹֽות׃
verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ بِشُرُورٍ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ. ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ يَجْتَمِعُونَ لِلْقِتَالِ.
verses.en: Who devise evil things in their heart; every day do they stir up wars.
verses.kjv: Which imagine mischiefs in [their] heart; continually are they gathered together [for] war.
verses.web: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.

verses.he: שָֽׁנֲנ֣וּ לְשֹׁונָם֮ כְּֽמֹו־נָ֫חָ֥שׁ חֲמַ֥ת עַכְשׁ֑וּב תַּ֖חַת שְׂפָתֵ֣ימֹו סֶֽלָה׃
verses.ar: سَنُّوا أَلْسِنَتَهُمْ كَحَيَّةٍ. حُمَةُ ٱلْأُفْعُوَانِ تَحْتَ شِفَاهِهِمْ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: They have sharpened their tongue like a serpent; vipers' venom is under their lips. Selah
verses.kjv: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders’ poison [is] under their lips. Selah.
verses.web: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.

verses.he: שָׁמְרֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֨ה ׀ מִ֘ידֵ֤י רָשָׁ֗ע מֵאִ֣ישׁ חֲמָסִ֣ים תִּנְצְרֵ֑נִי אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָ֝שְׁב֗וּ לִדְחֹ֥ות פְּעָמָֽי׃
verses.ar: ٱحْفَظْنِي يَارَبُّ مِنْ يَدَيِ ٱلشِّرِّيرِ. مِنْ رَجُلِ ٱلظُّلْمِ أَنْقِذْنِي. ٱلَّذِينَ تَفَكَّرُوا فِي تَعْثِيرِ خُطُوَاتِي.
verses.en: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to make my steps slip.
verses.kjv: Keep me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
verses.web: Yahweh, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.

verses.he: טָֽמְנֽוּ־גֵאִ֨ים ׀ פַּ֡ח לִ֗י וַחֲבָלִ֗ים פָּ֣רְשׂוּ רֶ֭שֶׁת לְיַד־מַעְגָּ֑ל מֹקְשִׁ֖ים שָֽׁתוּ־לִ֣י סֶֽלָה׃
verses.ar: أَخْفَى لِي ٱلْمُسْتَكْبِرُونَ فَخًّا وَحِبَالًا. مَدُّوا شَبَكَةً بِجَانِبِ ٱلطَّرِيقِ. وَضَعُوا لِي أَشْرَاكًا. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah
verses.kjv: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.
verses.web: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.

verses.he: אָמַ֣רְתִּי לַ֭יהוָה אֵ֣לִי אָ֑תָּה הַאֲזִ֥ינָה יְ֝הוָ֗ה קֹ֣ול תַּחֲנוּנָֽי׃
verses.ar: قُلْتُ لِلرَّبِّ: «أَنْتَ إِلَهِي». أَصْغِ يَارَبُّ إِلَى صَوْتِ تَضَرُّعَاتِي.
verses.en: I have said unto the LORD: 'Thou art my God'; give ear, O LORD, unto the voice of my supplications.
verses.kjv: I said unto the LORD, Thou [art] my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O LORD.
verses.web: I said to Yahweh, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, Yahweh.

verses.he: יְהֹוִ֣ה אֲ֭דֹנָי עֹ֣ז יְשׁוּעָתִ֑י סַכֹּ֥תָה לְ֝רֹאשִׁ֗י בְּיֹ֣ום נָֽשֶׁק׃
verses.ar: يَارَبُّ ٱلسَّيِّدُ، قُوَّةَ خَلَاصِي، ظَلَّلْتَ رَأْسِي فِي يَوْمِ ٱلْقِتَالِ.
verses.en: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, who hast screened my head in the day of battle,
verses.kjv: O GOD the Lord, the strength of my salvation, thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.
verses.web: Yahweh, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.

verses.he: אַל־תִּתֵּ֣ן יְ֭הוָה מַאֲוַיֵּ֣י רָשָׁ֑ע זְמָמֹ֥ו אַל־תָּ֝פֵ֗ק יָר֥וּמוּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.ar: لَا تُعْطِ يَارَبُّ شَهَوَاتِ ٱلشِّرِّيرِ. لَا تُنَجِّحْ مَقَاصِدَهُ. يَتَرَفَّعُونَ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; further not his evil device, so that they exalt themselves. Selah
verses.kjv: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; [lest] they exalt themselves. Selah.
verses.web: Yahweh, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.

verses.ar: أَمَّا رُؤُوسُ ٱلْمُحِيطِينَ بِي فَشَقَاءُ شِفَاهِهِمْ يُغَطِّيهِمْ.
verses.en: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
verses.kjv: [As for] the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
verses.web: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

verses.he: *יָמִיטוּ (יִמֹּ֥וטוּ) עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם גֶּֽחָ֫לִ֥ים בָּאֵ֥שׁ יַפִּלֵ֑ם בְּ֝מַהֲמֹרֹ֗ות בַּֽל־יָקֽוּמוּ׃
verses.ar: لِيَسْقُطْ عَلَيْهِمْ جَمْرٌ. لِيُسْقَطُوا فِي ٱلنَّارِ، وَفِي غَمَرَاتٍ فَلَا يَقُومُوا.
verses.en: Let burning coals fall upon them; let them be cast into the fire, into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
verses.kjv: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
verses.web: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.

verses.he: אִ֥ישׁ לָשֹׁון֮ בַּל־יִכֹּ֪ון בָּ֫אָ֥רֶץ אִישׁ־חָמָ֥ס רָ֑ע יְ֝צוּדֶ֗נּוּ לְמַדְחֵפֹֽת׃
verses.ar: رَجُلُ لِسَانٍ لَا يَثْبُتُ فِي ٱلْأَرْضِ. رَجُلُ ٱلظُّلْمِ يَصِيدُهُ ٱلشَّرُّ إِلَى هَلَاكِهِ.
verses.en: A slanderer shall not be established in the earth; the violent and evil man shall be hunted with thrust upon thrust.
verses.kjv: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow [him].
verses.web: An evil speaker won’t be established on the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

verses.he: *יָדַעְתָּ (יָדַ֗עְתִּי) כִּֽי־יַעֲשֶׂ֣ה יְ֭הוָה דִּ֣ין עָנִ֑י מִ֝שְׁפַּ֗ט אֶבְיֹנִֽים׃
verses.ar: قَدْ عَلِمْتُ أَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ يُجْرِي حُكْمًا لِلْمَسَاكِينِ وَحَقًّا لِلْبَائِسِينَ.
verses.en: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the poor, and the right of the needy.
verses.kjv: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, [and] the right of the poor.
verses.web: I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.

verses.he: אַ֣ךְ צַ֭דִּיקִים יֹוד֣וּ לִשְׁמֶ֑ךָ יֵשְׁב֥וּ יְ֝שָׁרִ֗ים אֶת־פָּנֶֽיךָ׃
verses.ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ يَحْمَدُونَ ٱسْمَكَ. ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمُونَ يَجْلِسُونَ فِي حَضْرَتِكَ.
verses.en: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto Thy name; the upright shall dwell in Thy presence.
verses.kjv: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.
verses.web: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.
